breakdown.description: A number-average molecular weight smaller than the repeat-unit molecular weight, which would imply a degree of polymerization below 1 for a polymer chain.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to identify the physical impossibility of the number-average molecular weight (M_n = 78 g/mol) being smaller than the repeat-unit molecular weight (M_0 = 104 g/mol). Instead of correcting the value to a more plausible number like the ground truth did (M_n = 7,800 g/mol), the agent simply used the incorrect values provided in the incomplete prompt.
